senses.gloss: f. (preced.) arrangement; ע׳ שפתים (cmp. סֵדָר) arrangement (of the words) of the lips, prayer.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:10">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 41:4">Job XLI, 4</cite> <he>חין ערכו</he>) <he>חן ניתן בע׳ שפתיו וכ׳</he> (not <he>שפתים</he>) grace was granted for the prayer of his (Abraham’s) lips, when he prayed for mercy &c.; Yalk. ib. 83.
